name: Indoco Remedies Limited
summary: Indoco Remedies Limited manufactures and markets formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients in India and internationally. It offers products for gastrointestinal, anti-infectives, respiratory, stomatological, vitamins/minerals/nutrients, urological, ophthal/ontological, dermatology, pain/analgesic, cardiac, anti-diabetic, and gynaecological therapeutic areas.
